verdict.rationale: Lium's developer API docs reference a downloadable OpenAPI spec at https://lium.io/api/openapi.json and show it being fed into openapi-typescript to generate types, which is a machine-readable spec an agent can fetch. The probe's 404s were all on docs.lium.io paths, not the documented lium.io/api/openapi.json, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that the documented lium.io/api/openapi.json URL resolves, and fuller documentation of the spec's coverage and versioning beyond a single code-snippet mention.
